description_en: Updates the configuration of the Automatic Resource Transfer feature. You can update only the configuration of the Transfer Existing Associated Resources feature
description_zh: 调用UpdateAutoGroupingConfig更新自动转组设置。目前仅支持设置是否开启存量关联资源跟随转组任务
name: UpdateAutoGroupingConfig

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the Transfer Existing Associated Resources feature. Valid values:

*   false
*   true
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启存量关联资源跟随转组任务。取值：

- false：不开启存量关联资源跟随转组任务。
- true：开启存量关联资源跟随转组任务
parameters.name: enable_existing_resources_transfer
